caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device constructed primarily of wood and metal. On the left side, there is a large wooden wheel with eight spokes, supported by a vertical wooden frame. The wheel is attached to a horizontal wooden beam and is connected by a thin black belt to a wooden spindle assembly fixed on top of the beam. Attached to the wheel's shaft is a metal crank handle. Moving to the right along the horizontal beam, there are two upright wooden posts or holders mounted on the beam and spaced apart. Between them is a small metal anvil, secured to the beam. The rightmost part of the device features a wooden clamp with a metal screw and handle for tightening, mounted vertically onto the beam. The entirety of the structure is supported at either end by wooden legs. The wood is depicted in shades of light brown with visible grain, while the metal parts are shown in gray or metallic tones. The background is plain and a light beige color, without additional objects or embellishments.
title: Bishop Hill: Woodturning Lathe
